title: Add REPL testing skill
body:
Adds a reusable REPL testing skill for Mumei CLI changes that touch `src/main.rs`, `mumei-emit-llvm/src/jit.rs`, `tests/test_repl.rs`, or std FFI loading. The skill captures the exact local command flow and concrete pass/fail assertions learned during runtime testing.

Devin Session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/7d23fbd2f8d34393ab3c845bc0235ac8
